title: ECPR General Conference 2027
level: Researchers (open call for panels and papers)
about: The ECPR General Conference 2027 takes place 7 to 10 September 2027 at Pompeu Fabra University, Barcelona. Panel and individual paper proposals can be submitted online in English from 17 November 2026 until midnight UK time on 8 January 2027.
card_alt: Card for the ECPR General Conference 2027 by the European Consortium for Political Research (ECPR) in Barcelona, Spain, with a panel and paper proposal deadline of 8 Jan 2027. The photo shows the Sagrada Família in Barcelona.
